newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan polyester yarn makers up on price hikes.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan polyester yarn makers up on price hikes.

text.p: Taiwan's polyester yarn shares surged at mid-morning on Friday as makers decided to raise prices for partially oriented yarn and polyester drawn texturised yarn in May, brokers said.
Both products are raw materials for polyester fibre.
After 80 minutes, Hong Yi Fiber rose T$1.4 or 2.86 percent to T$50.5 and Lan Fa Textile surged T$1.3 or 3.53 percent to T$38.2.
Polyester fibre maker Tuntex Distinct and other local makers would raise polyester yarn prices from May, a Tuntex spokesman told Reuters.
"We have decided to raise polyester yarn prices from May due to rising demand," the spokesman said, but declined to give the level of the price adjustment.
Brokers said the price rises reflect rising demand triggered by the recovering domestic economy.
"The price hikes reflect the recovering economy, so related share prices have the potential to rise some 15 percent in the next three months," said Michael Hung, an independent senior analyst.
